dialect.detail: IBM DB2 embedded SQL, Italian-language project 'NEWLIFE', standard DB2 precompiler pattern with SQLCA, cursor management, and historical table update patterns

purpose.domain_detail: Italian insurance/financial system (NEWLIFE project) - DB2 database access module for AMMB_FUNZ_BLOCCO table handling functional blocks with historical and competency-based record management
purpose.summary: This is a DB2 database access subprogram for the NEWLIFE project, providing standardized CRUD and cursor operations on the AMMB_FUNZ_BLOCCO table. It supports multiple access patterns including primary key, parent ID, object IB, secondary IB, and object ID, with both historical effect and competency date variants. The program acts as a data service layer called by higher-level business logic via a standard service interface (IDSV0003).

notable_features: EXEC SQL embedded DB2 (multiple INCLUDE copybooks: SQLCA, IDSV0010, IDBDL160, IDBVL162, IDBVL161)
Cursor management (OPEN/CLOSE/FETCH-FIRST/FETCH-NEXT) for multiple access paths
Standardized service interface via IDSV0003 linkage area
132 PERFORM statements with structured paragraph naming convention
